import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normal_inf_normal_specialization {G : Type*} [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G)
  [hH : H.Normal] [hK : K.Normal] : (H ⊓ K).Normal := by
  refine ⟨fun n hn g => ?_⟩
  rw [Subgroup.mem_inf] at hn ⊢
  exact ⟨hH.conj_mem n hn.1 g, hK.conj_mem n hn.2 g⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normal_inf_normal_specialization {G : Type*} [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G)
  [hH : H.Normal] [hK : K.Normal] : (H ⊓ K).Normal := by
  let F : Bool → Subgroup G := fun b => if b then H else K
  have hFamily : (⨅ b : Bool, F b).Normal :=
    Subgroup.normal_iInf_normal (fun b => by
      cases b <;> simp [F, hH, hK])
  have hTwo : (⨅ b : Bool, F b) = H ⊓ K := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine le_inf ?_ ?_
      · exact iInf_le_of_le true (by simp [F])
      · exact iInf_le_of_le false (by simp [F])
    · refine le_iInf fun b => ?_
      cases b <;> simp [F]
  rw [← hTwo]
  exact hFamily
